programme.title: The Great South African Bake Off
programme.desc: With just 4 bakers left in the competition, the pressure has ramped up once again with patisserie week, including bombe, and a difficult bake reportedly dedicated to the patron saint of baking. programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Cisco’s been kidnapped! The team scrambles to get him back, but Tony and Echo disagree on the best plan of action.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Phil learns no one on the farm thinks he's fun, he sets out to prove them all wrong... by building a crazy amusement park.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Eep and Dawn find a stranded egg, they eagerly take it in as their new pet, but when they learn the egg is not what it seems, they have to return it before it becomes dangerous.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Grug overhears Thunk accidentally call Phil "Dad", he tries to reconnect with Thunk by taking him to the natural spectacle known as "Big Shine."

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom attempts to defeat the World Serpent by emulating Hiccup.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom and the dragon riders foster displaced Hidden Realm dragons in Rakke Town but things get complicated when Mr. Rakke makes a surprise visit.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Right before basketball tryouts, Peng learns from NaiNai that it is his “big bad” year on the zodiac calendar – which means bad luck. Peng is skeptical at first, but after seeing the positive effects of adhering to NaiNai’s superstitions, he dives headfirst into learning all he can to secure his spot on the team. Eventually, he becomes so consumed that he “breaks up” with Yi and Jin because of their zodiac incompatibility. Cut from tryouts, Peng eventually realizes with the help of his friends that he went overboard and he has more to offer than just basketball.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crew’s life just as the dumpling shop is being reviewed by a food magazine writer. Overwhelmed by her efforts to help her mom and NaiNai in the shop, Yi asks the toad to spit up helpful items – but Jin and Peng aren’t so selfless. As a result of granting an abundance of wishes for the whole crew, the toad becomes too weak to continue. Realizing the error of their ways and why the toad appeared in the first place, Yi and Everest use their magic to reverse the toad’s magic onto himself so he can wish himself home.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Sandra insists on breaking the gender barrier of a “boys only” skateboard race. But the race is one with a history for being incredibly dangerous. Will Sandra let Liam “save” her or will she save her reputation as the coolest sk8terchick at Cosmos High?

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A little white lie told to his ping-pong loving grandmother forces Raffi to actually try out for the team when they make the finals. Grandma is keen to see her favourite grandson play her favourite sport and he's not about to let her down. It soon becomes apparent that normally athletic Raffi is all thumbs when it comes to what team captain Antoine pretentiously refers to as table tennis.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Spring has sprung and love is in the air at Cosmos High. When the other pods pressure Sandra and Raffi to couple-up, lovelorn Birch and Liam decide to take matters into their own hands ensuring that the reluctant pair don't end up together.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A cute guy into comics mistakes Birch's artwork as Sandra's comic. When the ruse is revealed, he falls for Birch. Sandra's ire rises, but both girls ultimately find out they've got a High School Lothario on their hands and reveal him to the sisterhood of Cosmos High.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia and Francine both volunteer to be classroom pet monitor, so the teacher, Mrs. Hogenmuller, tells them each to explain why they deserve the job. Francine initially wins over the class with the help of her charming cat, Gwendolyn, but when it's revealed that Francine is afraid of the class lizard, everyone is happy for Olivia to take over the job - especially Francine!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When school is let out early due to snow, Julian and Francine come over to Olivia's house. Olivia has the perfect game for them – Hotel! She transforms her house into a make-believe hotel. But then some strange things start to happen. Does the hotel have ghosts, or is Ian just playing tricks on them?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Mother is busy planning a birthday party for Francine, and Olivia wants to help. The big surprise – TV star Kicky the Kangaroo -is due to make a special appearance. But when unexpected problems confront Kicky, Olivia has to step in and save Francine's party!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: In preparation for their class track and field day – dubbed the “Hogenmuller Games” after their teacher -Olivia uses a unique training regiment to help her best friend Julian be the fastest runner he can be and to give herself a jump on the competition in her own event.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: Cisco’s been kidnapped! The team scrambles to get him back, but Tony and Echo disagree on the best plan of action.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers
programme.desc: The team is reunited, but now they must race against the clock to stop Dann from setting off an explosion that will melt the polar ice caps and send the world into a new Ice Age.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Phil learns no one on the farm thinks he's fun, he sets out to prove them all wrong... by building a crazy amusement park.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Eep and Dawn find a stranded egg, they eagerly take it in as their new pet, but when they learn the egg is not what it seems, they have to return it before it becomes dangerous.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Grug overhears Thunk accidentally call Phil "Dad", he tries to reconnect with Thunk by taking him to the natural spectacle known as "Big Shine."

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom attempts to defeat the World Serpent by emulating Hiccup.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom and the dragon riders foster displaced Hidden Realm dragons in Rakke Town but things get complicated when Mr. Rakke makes a surprise visit.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Right before basketball tryouts, Peng learns from NaiNai that it is his “big bad” year on the zodiac calendar – which means bad luck. Peng is skeptical at first, but after seeing the positive effects of adhering to NaiNai’s superstitions, he dives headfirst into learning all he can to secure his spot on the team. Eventually, he becomes so consumed that he “breaks up” with Yi and Jin because of their zodiac incompatibility. Cut from tryouts, Peng eventually realizes with the help of his friends that he went overboard and he has more to offer than just basketball.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crew’s life just as the dumpling shop is being reviewed by a food magazine writer. Overwhelmed by her efforts to help her mom and NaiNai in the shop, Yi asks the toad to spit up helpful items – but Jin and Peng aren’t so selfless. As a result of granting an abundance of wishes for the whole crew, the toad becomes too weak to continue. Realizing the error of their ways and why the toad appeared in the first place, Yi and Everest use their magic to reverse the toad’s magic onto himself so he can wish himself home.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Sandra insists on breaking the gender barrier of a “boys only” skateboard race. But the race is one with a history for being incredibly dangerous. Will Sandra let Liam “save” her or will she save her reputation as the coolest sk8terchick at Cosmos High?

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A little white lie told to his ping-pong loving grandmother forces Raffi to actually try out for the team when they make the finals. Grandma is keen to see her favourite grandson play her favourite sport and he's not about to let her down. It soon becomes apparent that normally athletic Raffi is all thumbs when it comes to what team captain Antoine pretentiously refers to as table tennis.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Spring has sprung and love is in the air at Cosmos High. When the other pods pressure Sandra and Raffi to couple-up, lovelorn Birch and Liam decide to take matters into their own hands ensuring that the reluctant pair don't end up together.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A cute guy into comics mistakes Birch's artwork as Sandra's comic. When the ruse is revealed, he falls for Birch. Sandra's ire rises, but both girls ultimately find out they've got a High School Lothario on their hands and reveal him to the sisterhood of Cosmos High.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia and Francine both volunteer to be classroom pet monitor, so the teacher, Mrs. Hogenmuller, tells them each to explain why they deserve the job. Francine initially wins over the class with the help of her charming cat, Gwendolyn, but when it's revealed that Francine is afraid of the class lizard, everyone is happy for Olivia to take over the job - especially Francine!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When school is let out early due to snow, Julian and Francine come over to Olivia's house. Olivia has the perfect game for them – Hotel! She transforms her house into a make-believe hotel. But then some strange things start to happen. Does the hotel have ghosts, or is Ian just playing tricks on them?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Mother is busy planning a birthday party for Francine, and Olivia wants to help. The big surprise – TV star Kicky the Kangaroo -is due to make a special appearance. But when unexpected problems confront Kicky, Olivia has to step in and save Francine's party!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: In preparation for their class track and field day – dubbed the “Hogenmuller Games” after their teacher -Olivia uses a unique training regiment to help her best friend Julian be the fastest runner he can be and to give herself a jump on the competition in her own event.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Phil learns no one on the farm thinks he's fun, he sets out to prove them all wrong... by building a crazy amusement park.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Eep and Dawn find a stranded egg, they eagerly take it in as their new pet, but when they learn the egg is not what it seems, they have to return it before it becomes dangerous.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree
programme.desc: When Grug overhears Thunk accidentally call Phil "Dad", he tries to reconnect with Thunk by taking him to the natural spectacle known as "Big Shine."

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom attempts to defeat the World Serpent by emulating Hiccup.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2
programme.desc: Tom and the dragon riders foster displaced Hidden Realm dragons in Rakke Town but things get complicated when Mr. Rakke makes a surprise visit.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: Right before basketball tryouts, Peng learns from NaiNai that it is his “big bad” year on the zodiac calendar – which means bad luck. Peng is skeptical at first, but after seeing the positive effects of adhering to NaiNai’s superstitions, he dives headfirst into learning all he can to secure his spot on the team. Eventually, he becomes so consumed that he “breaks up” with Yi and Jin because of their zodiac incompatibility. Cut from tryouts, Peng eventually realizes with the help of his friends that he went overboard and he has more to offer than just basketball.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City
programme.desc: A wish-granting toad drops into Yi and the crew’s life just as the dumpling shop is being reviewed by a food magazine writer. Overwhelmed by her efforts to help her mom and NaiNai in the shop, Yi asks the toad to spit up helpful items – but Jin and Peng aren’t so selfless. As a result of granting an abundance of wishes for the whole crew, the toad becomes too weak to continue. Realizing the error of their ways and why the toad appeared in the first place, Yi and Everest use their magic to reverse the toad’s magic onto himself so he can wish himself home.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Sandra insists on breaking the gender barrier of a “boys only” skateboard race. But the race is one with a history for being incredibly dangerous. Will Sandra let Liam “save” her or will she save her reputation as the coolest sk8terchick at Cosmos High?

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A little white lie told to his ping-pong loving grandmother forces Raffi to actually try out for the team when they make the finals. Grandma is keen to see her favourite grandson play her favourite sport and he's not about to let her down. It soon becomes apparent that normally athletic Raffi is all thumbs when it comes to what team captain Antoine pretentiously refers to as table tennis.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: Spring has sprung and love is in the air at Cosmos High. When the other pods pressure Sandra and Raffi to couple-up, lovelorn Birch and Liam decide to take matters into their own hands ensuring that the reluctant pair don't end up together.

programme.title: My Life Me
programme.desc: A cute guy into comics mistakes Birch's artwork as Sandra's comic. When the ruse is revealed, he falls for Birch. Sandra's ire rises, but both girls ultimately find out they've got a High School Lothario on their hands and reveal him to the sisterhood of Cosmos High.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia and Francine both volunteer to be classroom pet monitor, so the teacher, Mrs. Hogenmuller, tells them each to explain why they deserve the job. Francine initially wins over the class with the help of her charming cat, Gwendolyn, but when it's revealed that Francine is afraid of the class lizard, everyone is happy for Olivia to take over the job - especially Francine!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When school is let out early due to snow, Julian and Francine come over to Olivia's house. Olivia has the perfect game for them – Hotel! She transforms her house into a make-believe hotel. But then some strange things start to happen. Does the hotel have ghosts, or is Ian just playing tricks on them?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Mother is busy planning a birthday party for Francine, and Olivia wants to help. The big surprise – TV star Kicky the Kangaroo -is due to make a special appearance. But when unexpected problems confront Kicky, Olivia has to step in and save Francine's party!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: In preparation for their class track and field day – dubbed the “Hogenmuller Games” after their teacher -Olivia uses a unique training regiment to help her best friend Julian be the fastest runner he can be and to give herself a jump on the competition in her own event.

programme.title: Boston Blue (Season 1)
programme.desc: Mae faces public and family backlash over the consequences of her past decisions, while Sarah struggles with guilt that pushes her to take risks in pursuit of justice. At the same time, Lena and Danny dive into a tense homicide case, and Jonah’s anger over his father’s death threatens to unravel fragile family ties.

programme.title: Doc (Season 2)
programme.desc: Chief resident race heats up as Amy and Sonya judge each other's cases; a politician's crisis threatens a vote, and Michael's parents stir drama.

programme.title: Elsbeth (Season 2)
programme.desc: Elsbeth matches wits with a professional psychic after one of her clients is found murdered.

programme.title: NCIS: Origins (Season 2)
programme.desc: When a lieutenant's water-logged body is discovered with a potential connection to an international smuggling ring, NIS Panama agents are called in to assist, and Gibbs comes face-to-face with an old nemesis: Special Agent Dwayne Pride.

programme.title: Blue Bloods (Season 14)
programme.desc: Danny and his nephew Joe Hill (Will Hochman) investigate the homicide of a delivery driver who may have been connected to an illegal narcotics ring in the city.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex (Season 6)
programme.desc: Charlie and Rex go undercover in prison to investigate the murder of David Aziz, a Robin Hood criminal Charlie arrested in the past.

programme.title: Boston Blue (Season 1)
programme.desc: Mae faces public and family backlash over the consequences of her past decisions, while Sarah struggles with guilt that pushes her to take risks in pursuit of justice. At the same time, Lena and Danny dive into a tense homicide case, and Jonah’s anger over his father’s death threatens to unravel fragile family ties.

programme.title: Doc (Season 2)
programme.desc: Chief resident race heats up as Amy and Sonya judge each other's cases; a politician's crisis threatens a vote, and Michael's parents stir drama.

programme.title: Elsbeth (Season 2)
programme.desc: Elsbeth matches wits with a professional psychic after one of her clients is found murdered.

programme.title: NCIS: Origins (Season 2)
programme.desc: When a lieutenant's water-logged body is discovered with a potential connection to an international smuggling ring, NIS Panama agents are called in to assist, and Gibbs comes face-to-face with an old nemesis: Special Agent Dwayne Pride.

programme.title: Blue Bloods (Season 14)
programme.desc: Danny and his nephew Joe Hill (Will Hochman) investigate the homicide of a delivery driver who may have been connected to an illegal narcotics ring in the city.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex (Season 6)
programme.desc: Charlie and Rex go undercover in prison to investigate the murder of David Aziz, a Robin Hood criminal Charlie arrested in the past.

programme.desc: 52 before JC. The city of Lutecia is occupied by the Romans... Completely? No! A gang of invincible animals led by Idefix resist the invader again and again and its plans to romanise the city.

In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.desc: Billy grew up in the Far West. He already has his cowboy outfit and has a burning desire to go on great adventures! With his inseparable friends, Jean-Claude, the earthworm, and Suzie, the little ferret, they're off to face situations as thorny as a cactus.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Une Famille
programme.desc: The author Christine Angot returns to Strasbourg, the city where she met her father at the age of 13 and where he raped her for the first time. Interviewing family and friends, she reopens wounds, forces open doors and examines the mechanisms of incest. A powerful, urgent and important film.

programme.title: Un Bon Garcon
programme.desc: Max, a talented 16-year-old swimmer, is getting ready to enter the sports studies programme. Between training sessions and outings with his friends, he leads the life of an average teenager. But when the police turn up one day to question his coach, who has been accused of sexual abuse, his regulated life is turned upside down.

programme.title: Foreigners
programme.desc: Jim, 15, is deeply shaken by the arrival of Neil, his British father whom he hasn't seen in five years. The teenager is about to be adopted by his stepfather, with whom he has formed a true bond. But Neil refuses to give up his parental rights...

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Stephane tries to calm several Tourette syndrome crises and has to solve a problem with glasses. Meanwhile, Mike fancies himself a poet, and Caro mourns the loss of a loved one.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Tired of being labeled the worst swimmer, Stephane quits the club. Charles finds an innovative solution to protect Catherine's hair, while Pierre invites the team to make a powerful video to raise donations.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Mike's wheelchair has been stolen. Valerie suggests a solution to help him out. It's time for the club's board meeting in the locker room: an opportunity to gather or just to snack? A special guest puts Stephane in his place.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Sarah receives a very special trophy to reward her efforts. The team is preparing a surprise for Emmanuel. Who will be the most surprised? At the end of the season, to lift everyone's spirits, Pierre suggests a call-and-response song for the whole group.

programme.title: Plus Qu'Hier, Moins Que Demain
programme.desc: On this summer morning, no one is expecting Sonia, who reappears in the village, among her own people, after a long absence, with her baby and her husband. Determined to wipe the slate clean, the young woman brings painful memories back to the surface. Sorrows, confessions, the violence of feelings, an overlooked gem of French cinema.

programme.title: En Voiture Clara

programme.title: Secrets De Nos Vallees
programme.desc: In the Var, Lake Saint-Cassien, rich in biodiversity, attracts fishing enthusiasts in search of a fish over 2 meters long. Introduced illegally, this predator disrupted the ecosystem before self-regulating, arousing the interest of specialists who study its impact on local wildlife.

programme.title: Le Crime Lui Va Si Bien
programme.desc: A man is found in a ditch, killed by a bullet between the eyes. Apparently connected to the Italian mafia, it's the trail Celine Richer enthusiastically decides to follow. Meanwhile Gaby Molina feels the truth probably lies elsewhere. And what if they decided to go their own separate ways?

programme.title: Tendance XXI
programme.desc: Ivorian creativity is making its mark in Paris thanks to Olivia Perez. Everything you need to know about the Ralph Lauren Bear polo shirt, an iconic piece from the New York-based brand. Handmade soap still has plenty to offer. Welcome to Ciment, a soap-making workshop with a rather surprising name! The return of the apron to our wardrobes.

programme.desc: Everyone thinks that the purple rabbit in Max's arms is a stuffed toy. But not at all! For Max, it really is a rabbit, to whom he confides his dreams and secrets. The two of them have fun together, comfort each other, and bicker.

programme.desc: Everyone thinks that the purple rabbit in Max's arms is a stuffed toy. But not at all! For Max, it really is a rabbit, to whom he confides his dreams and secrets. The two of them have fun together, comfort each other, and bicker.

programme.title: Idefix Et Les Irreductibles
programme.desc: 52 before JC. The city of Lutecia is occupied by the Romans... Completely? No! A gang of invincible animals led by Idefix resist the invader again and again and its plans to romanise the city.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi
programme.desc: Olive, Petole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: Billy Le Hamster Cowboy
programme.desc: Billy grew up in the Far West. He already has his cowboy outfit and has a burning desire to go on great adventures! With his inseparable friends, Jean-Claude, the earthworm, and Suzie, the little ferret, they're off to face situations as thorny as a cactus.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Une Famille
programme.desc: The author Christine Angot returns to Strasbourg, the city where she met her father at the age of 13 and where he raped her for the first time. Interviewing family and friends, she reopens wounds, forces open doors and examines the mechanisms of incest. A powerful, urgent and important film.

programme.title: Un Bon Garcon
programme.desc: Max, a talented 16-year-old swimmer, is getting ready to enter the sports studies programme. Between training sessions and outings with his friends, he leads the life of an average teenager. But when the police turn up one day to question his coach, who has been accused of sexual abuse, his regulated life is turned upside down.

programme.title: Foreigners
programme.desc: Jim, 15, is deeply shaken by the arrival of Neil, his British father whom he hasn't seen in five years. The teenager is about to be adopted by his stepfather, with whom he has formed a true bond. But Neil refuses to give up his parental rights...

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Stephane tries to calm several Tourette syndrome crises and has to solve a problem with glasses. Meanwhile, Mike fancies himself a poet, and Caro mourns the loss of a loved one.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Tired of being labeled the worst swimmer, Stephane quits the club. Charles finds an innovative solution to protect Catherine's hair, while Pierre invites the team to make a powerful video to raise donations.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Mike's wheelchair has been stolen. Valerie suggests a solution to help him out. It's time for the club's board meeting in the locker room: an opportunity to gather or just to snack? A special guest puts Stephane in his place.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Sarah receives a very special trophy to reward her efforts. The team is preparing a surprise for Emmanuel. Who will be the most surprised? At the end of the season, to lift everyone's spirits, Pierre suggests a call-and-response song for the whole group.

programme.title: Plus Qu'Hier, Moins Que Demain
programme.desc: On this summer morning, no one is expecting Sonia, who reappears in the village, among her own people, after a long absence, with her baby and her husband.
